guardedThrowRisks: MOOD_LY_CALLS_mMA: reading i.currentTime in a logpoint is safe ONLY inside the i&& branch; any expression must still be wrapped typeof-guarded because a logpoint bound one statement early would hit TDZ on i (const).
MOOD_LY_ENTRY: A is defaulted ({}) at entry, safe. e may be null - property reads must be optional.
AUTHORITY_* : na may be undefined; do not read na.gain unguarded.
Every logpoint expression MUST be wrapped in try{...}catch(_){} and terminate in ,!1 (non-pausing). Caught errors must be counted and reported as evaluationErrors, never silently dropped.
Null-checks do NOT protect against undeclared/TDZ identifiers; only try/catch does.

samplingPolicy.problem: per-frame/per-call logpoints on LY/mMA can exhaust the 4000 cap BEFORE the finale completes, producing a truncated buffer that looks like a clean run.
samplingPolicy.rule: emit only when (a) the deadline observation age>=4.8s, or (b) it is the FIRST live occurrence of that pin id; all other hits increment a per-pin droppedCount that MUST be emitted in the final record.
samplingPolicy.flushing: event buffer must be written through a finally block so a thrown/aborted capture still yields the partial buffer plus dropped counts.
